subject: Preflight runway & owner pact — Brightline onboarding
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Sara Li <sara@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Preflight runway & owner pact — Brightline onboarding

Hi team,

Following our scoping call with Brightline this morning, I'm capturing a short preflight so we can align owners and dates before we hand to CS. Goal: a two-week technical ramp (API keys, VPC peering validation, sample corpus ingestion) and a 30-day feature acceptance window.

Key asks:
- Can Engineering confirm estimated time for VPC peering & firewall rule test (tentative: 3 business days)? (Jordan)
- Can CS confirm which onboarding tasks require weekly touchpoints vs async sign-off? (Marissa/Tessa)
- Brightline to provide a sample dataset extract and SSO metadata by 12/10. (Sara)

I've attached a lightweight checklist (Brightline_preflight_checklist.xlsx) with suggested milestones and owners. Please review and add specific dates in-column.

Proposed high-level milestones:
1) Access & network validation — target 12/11
2) Sample ingestion & validation — target 12/14
3) Policy & audit review — target 12/17
4) Acceptance testing kickoff — target 12/18

I'll set a short 30-minute sync for Monday if we need real-time decisions; otherwise let's triage in-thread.

Thanks —
Mina
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: Brightline_preflight_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12 rows)
From: Sara Li <sara@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Brightline IT <it@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Preflight runway & owner pact — Brightline onboarding

Thanks, Mina — this looks good. Quick confirmations from our side:
- We can get the sample dataset and SSO metadata by 12/09 EOD.
- IT expects to unblock VPC peering by 12/12 assuming firewall rules are agreed.
- For acceptance testing, we prefer two weekly 30-minute checkpoints (Mon/Wed) for the first two weeks.

I'll review the checklist and add a column for Brightline's internal owners. If possible, please share any example ingestion scripts we can run in our pre-prod.

Best,
Sara Li
Director, Data Engineering | Brightline Health
sara@brightlinehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-3321
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara@brightlinehealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 06 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Preflight runway & owner pact — Brightline onboarding

Sara — great, thanks for the quick reply. I updated the attached owner-pact with two changes: explicit weekly checkpoint cadence and an alternate rollback window for ingestion if sample validation fails. See Brightline_owner-pact-v1.xlsx (sheet: Schedule).

Notes by owner: 
- Jordan (Engineering): validate VPC peering + run test ingestion script (target 12/12-12/13). Please confirm the script path after you push to staging.
- Tessa (CS): run the acceptance test template and schedule Mon/Wed 30m syncs starting 12/18.
- Mina (AE): keep procurement looped; expect SOW signature attempt on 12/15 (DocuSign link to follow).

If everyone is aligned I'll move this into the onboarding board and tag owners for the 12/07 readiness check.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (206) 555-0099

Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Preflight runway & owner pact — Brightline onboarding

Thanks all — aligned from CS side. Final confirmations and small updates: 

1) Checkpoint schedule: I'll create the recurring Mon/Wed 30-minute invites for 12/18 & 12/20 (planning window) and 12/25 will be skipped for holidays unless Brightline requests.
2) Acceptance template: I'm attaching the acceptance test checklist excerpt to the board. We'll run the first acceptance smoke tests on 12/18 and circulate results same-day.
3) Contingency: if sample ingestion fails by 12/14, we'll trigger a 3-day focused remediation sprint (owners: Jordan + Brightline IT) and pause the 12/18 acceptance kickoff until validation completes.

Mina — if procurement can push SOW review to complete by 12/15, we'll target go-live acceptance window starting 12/18 and a production enablement review on 01/06.

Sara — appreciate you committing to the dataset on 12/09. Please confirm once uploaded and I'll assign the smoke test tickets.

—Tessa
